experiments.title: Remove extension steps with warmup clamp
experiments.hypothesis: With warmup sampling clamped to total_steps, removing the 10 extension steps can run to completion and may still meet val_loss <= 3.28.

experiments.title: 1370 scheduled no extension with warmup clamp
experiments.hypothesis: After clamping warmup sampling, 1370 scheduled iterations without extension can test whether 15 fewer steps still meet the target.
experiments.command: VARIANT_ID=scheduled_1370_no_extension_warmup_clamp WARMUP_CLAMP=1 REPLACEMENTS_JSON='{"num_scheduled_iterations: int = 1375":"num_scheduled_iterations: int = 1370","num_extension_iterations: int = 10":"num_extension_iterations: int = 0"}' bash experiments/arthur/run_variant.sh
